environment.virtualizer: same locally patched QEMU 11.1.3 WHPX build as v8; isolated socket Ethernet
environment.iputils_version: 20240905 (reported by installed client and exit ping)

excluded_incomplete_acquisition: one probe-main attempt interrupted after identifying startup failure

method.traffic: unchanged 25k/s noise, 300000 packets per 12-second target, payload256, bursts up to4096; two native AWG clients at50Mbit/s each
method.rate_gate: source within1%, entry loss at most1%, zero switch drops; every offered noise packet independently counted
method.probe_before: ping -n -D -c100 -i0.02 -W1; terminal receive wait can be max(interval,2*previous max RTT)
method.probe_after: exactly100 raw IPv4 ICMP requests,56-byte payload,20-ms pacing, explicit1-second per-reply budget and final drain; no replacement requests
method.captures: client pf1/pf2 and exit awg0 ICMP; initial diagnostics also selected short encrypted UDP at three lab NICs; kernel capture-drop counters retained
method.observer_change: one full-capture corrected-probe run failed90% CPU and offered rate; final nine repeats retained inner ICMP captures and all drop counters
method.maintenance: one initial trial ran alongside unattended-upgrades and failed CPU; guest APT jobs were then confirmed idle and only disposable-guest timers masked
method.cpu_collection: same resident whole-VM nominal250-ms samples and sliding four-sample tick windows; includes observer/probe overhead
method.counter_scope: IPv4 background discard counters are not per-ICMP proof; selected echo identifiers/sequences traced independently
method.startup_failure_handling: raw probe replaced an unsupported datagram ping socket; eight failed-launch acquisitions excluded, not classified as network loss; harness now rejects empty output or stderr
method.historical_limit: v11 remaining missing sequence was100; no packet capture for that old event, so its exact cause is not retrospectively proven
method.public_data: checked CPU/counter/path summaries and arrival bins; raw PCAPs and complete jobs stay local
